title: SSL/TLS Certificates Subscription Renewal Terms
content:
Customer renewal terms for SSL/TLS Certificates subscriptions held with Harborline Hosting & Domains.

## Part A — Terms in force

**A.1 Status.** A renewal may be charged only while the subscription status is active. The status is the one on the subscription record for that subscription reference number; a subscription that is pending validation, expired, revoked or cancelled is not renewed under these terms.

**A.2 Renewal window.** A renewal may be bought from the product's early-renewal period in days before the subscription end date up to the end date itself, counting back whole calendar days from the end date. Both the first day of the window and the end date itself fall inside it.

**A.3 Expired subscriptions.** An expired subscription cannot be renewed and needs a new order.

| Position on the calendar | May a renewal be bought? |
|---|---|
| earlier than the first day of the renewal window | no |
| from the first day of the window up to and including the subscription end date | yes, while the subscription is active |
| after the subscription has expired | no; a new order is needed |

*Boundary pair (hypothetical).* For a subscription ending on 9 March 2034 on a product whose early-renewal period were 90 days, counting back 90 calendar days gives 9 December 2033: a renewal may be bought on 9 December 2033, but not on 8 December 2033.

## Part B — Terms no longer in force

Each clause below is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current pricing basis for support renewals, auto-renew charges and dashboard renewals.

**B.1** "A renewal extends the subscription from its subscription end date by 1 to the product's longest subscription in years, never from the payment date." This clause is no longer in force.

**B.2** "It is billed at the tier's price for the years renewed plus the extra names for those years, reduced by the account tier's SSL certificate discount percentage and rounded half up to the cent, and the volume ladder never applies to renewals." This clause is no longer in force.

**B.3** "Where auto-renew is on, the renewal for the same number of years as the last term, capped at the product's longest subscription, is charged the product's auto-renew lead time in days before the subscription end date using the account's funding order." This clause is no longer in force.

## Part C — Figure these terms read

**Account tier discount percentage:** the SSL certificate discount percentage that the Harborline Customer Accounts tier schedule sets for the customer's account tier.

superseded_clauses: A renewal extends the subscription from its subscription_end_date (renewal_extends_from) by 1 to max_subscription_years years, never from the payment date.

It is billed at the tier's price for the years renewed plus the extra names for those years, reduced by the account tier's ssl_discount_pct and rounded half up to the cent, and the volume ladder never applies to renewals.

Where auto_renew is true the renewal for the same number of years as the last term, capped at max_subscription_years, is charged auto_renew_days_before_end days before the subscription end date using the account charter's funding order.
